interface.source_evidence: Original problem lists vec, outv, o2, o1, o0 with these widths.

semantics.timing: Combinational connections; no clock, cycle delay, or input acceptance event.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior specified.
semantics.initialization: No storage or initialized state; outputs reflect input four-state values after combinational settling.
semantics.source_evidence: Original problem says outputs the same vector and connect o0 to position 0, o1 to position 1, etc.

numeric.bit_order: Position 0 is vec[0]; position 2 is vec[2].
numeric.arithmetic: None; no rounding, overflow, truncation, or signed interpretation.

verification.oracle: Original problem direct vector identity and specified bit positions.
verification.coverage: All eight binary vectors, repeated transitions, and all 64 combinations of 0/1/X/Z to check wire propagation.
verification.sampling: Drive inputs then sample after a 1 ns combinational settling interval; this is a testbench observation delay, not DUT latency.
verification.failure: $fatal on any case-inequality mismatch or bounded timeout.
